title: Agentic AI & AgentOps Specialization Bootcamp 3.0 with Cloud
_comment_overview: PARAPHRASED from the krishnaik.in landing page — never copy marketing prose verbatim. Facts (fee, duration, module count, frameworks, protocols, four capstones) are used as-is.
overview: A 5-6 month live cohort that takes practitioners with existing Python, ML, deep learning and NLP fundamentals into production-grade multi-agent engineering. Twenty-three modules cover the full 2026 agent framework landscape — LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, AWS Strands, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Claude Code, AutoGen, n8n and LangFlow — plus the MCP and A2A protocols, agentic RAG, context engineering, agent security and the full AgentOps observability lifecycle. It closes with four end-to-end capstone projects deployed across AWS, GCP, Azure and a fully local stack.
_comment_category: Primary is unambiguous — agent design patterns, orchestration and multi-agent systems dominate the syllabus. 'MLOps / LLMOps' secondary for the dedicated AgentOps/observability module and CI/CD deployment module; 'Cloud' secondary for the four-cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure/local) capstone architecture.
_comment_level: Unlike the sibling full-stack GenAI bootcamp (which explicitly welcomes newcomers to LLMs), this page states hard prerequisites — Python coding, NLP and deep learning knowledge, and GenAI basics — and targets 'experienced engineers looking to transition into production-grade multi-agent systems'. That rules out a pure-beginner anchor. It genuinely spans up to enterprise multi-cloud architecture (module 23), hence level_range; `level` alone is what fusion_rank scores.
_comment_price: ₹8000.00 stated inclusive of GST. Own-site cohort pricing, not coupon-driven, so a number is safe here. Band 'mid' per §2 (₹3,000-9,999).
_comment_rating: No star rating or review count published on the page. Null, not guessed — the validator's null-rating warning is expected.
